messages.subject: What is effort?
parts:
Hello everyone, 

I'm new to the distance sampling method and i'm doing research into feral pigeon populations. 

Currently im done with visualising my data into histograms and starting to work on the detection function models. 

But i seem to run into an issue which is "effort". i don't understand what this exactly means and how to work with it. 

Seeing as i have 9 reasearch areas with 15 lines each and i sample every area four times what effort do i need to use?

With kind regards,

Casolyn

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] What is effort?
parts:
Hello Casolyn

For line transect data as you have, there is effort associated with each of your (15x9) 135 transects. Each transect's effort is the length of the transect times the number of times it is walked. If your first transect was 1km in length, then the effort associated with that transect is 1km x 4 visits = 4km.
